decoded.note: RFC-0004 §B/§C canonical bytes; structured TLV, opt.PL=1, no trailers (at-rest form). Byte-for-byte `field-append` with the index_mode VALUE flipped 0x01→0x02 — the ONE-BYTE difference between appending a subscriber and addressing them all. Codec-valid here; `[*]` is legal only on a subscriber-path target at the resolution layer (see fwd/fwd-wildcard-reject).
